proposal.reason: Main functional change is in CU/CE dispatch policy application: strategy state is moved from per-comm/FUNC_INDEX slots to a process-wide cache keyed by (device,kernel), shared across native/user paths, with applied-state tracking and launchConfig returned from the cache to prevent stale-skip misapplication. Edits in enqueue/init/comm are supporting call-site/state-plumbing for this dispatch behavior, not independent communicator or enqueue policy changes.
